game.title: Elden Ring
game.blurb: Open-world soulslike action RPG from FromSoftware, released 2022-02-25. RAWG average playtime: 62 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes; the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion (2024) is listed separately on RAWG.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1245620)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Elden_Ring
Fandom (eldenring.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring
notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough and Achievements subpages are linked but not written. eldenring.fandom.com answers the API, but its game page links to only about 17 pages. 36 of 42 Steam achievements are hidden; most are named after bosses, so they were sorted by achievement name into Shardbearers, main-path bosses, optional bosses and endings. That split is an estimate and needs checking in play. Their "where" text stays spoiler-guarded.
